lessons.title: The news every day
lessons.goal: I can talk about the news.

newItems.definition: a TV or radio station
a person who watches TV

lessons.mainWordForms: Channel is a noun. Channel means a TV or radio station. I watch this channel.
lessons.expression: I watch the news every morning.
lessons.use: Use this when you talk about the news.
lessons.expressionTask: Tom and Lily talk about the news. What do they say?
lessons.grammar: present simple for news habits: I watch the news every morning
lessons.pattern: I watch the news every morning.
lessons.example: I watch the news every morning.
context: Tom and Lily talk about the news.
Tom says, 'I watch the news every morning. I follow the news on TV.'
dialogue: Lily, what is a channel?
It is a TV or radio station. I watch this channel.
What is a viewer?
It is a person who watches TV. The viewer likes the show.
Do you watch the news?
Yes. I watch the news every morning. I follow the news.
lessons.listening: Tom and Lily talk about the news. Tom says, 'I watch the news every morning. I follow the news on TV.' Lily says, 'What is a channel?' Tom says, 'It is a TV or radio station.' Lily says, 'What is a viewer?' Tom says, 'It is a person who watches TV.'
lessons.question: What do Tom and Lily talk about?
lessons.reading: On Monday, Tom and Lily talk about the news. Tom says, 'I watch the news every morning. I follow the news on TV. This is the latest news today.' Lily says, 'What is a channel?' Tom says, 'It is a TV or radio station. I watch this channel every day. A channel has many shows.' Lily says, 'What is a viewer?' Tom says, 'It is a person who watches TV. The viewer likes the show. I like the news. We watch the news with our friends. I follow the news every day. This is the latest news for us. A viewer can watch the news in the morning. I watch the news and I learn new things.'
lessons.readingQ: What do Tom and Lily talk about?
lessons.speaking: Tell a friend about the news. What do you say?
lessons.speakingSample: I talk about the news with my friend Tom. I watch the news every morning. I follow the news on TV. This is the latest news today. I watch this channel every day. The viewer likes the show. I like the news very much. We watch the news with our friends.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend about the news. Say what you do.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Anna, I want to tell you about the news. I watch the news every morning. I follow the news on TV. This is the latest news today. I watch this channel every day. The viewer likes the show. I like the news very much. We watch the news with our friends. The news is good for all of us. See you soon. Best, Lily
lessons.sound: Channel has its strongest beat on CHAN. In channel, say CHAN clearly at the start. In viewer, say VIEW clearly at the start.
